Dermal Fillers Types Benefits Cost in Trivandrum

Aging is natural—but looking tired or older than you feel doesn't have to be. If you’re noticing fine lines, sagging skin, or loss of volume in your face, it’s normal to feel a little frustrated or self-conscious.

Here’s the good news: dermal fillers offer a safe, non-surgical solution to restore youthfulness, refresh your appearance, and most importantly—boost your confidence.

At Facelit Clinic in Trivandrum, we specialize in advanced, personalized dermal filler treatments that bring out your natural beauty while addressing your unique concerns.

What Are Dermal Fillers?

Dermal fillers are injectable gels used to restore volume, smooth out wrinkles, enhance facial contours, and rejuvenate the skin. Most commonly made of hyaluronic acid, a substance naturally found in your body, fillers provide instant results without surgery.

Unlike Botox (which relaxes muscles), fillers plump and lift the skin, helping you achieve a fresher and more youthful look.

Think of dermal fillers as your skin’s subtle support system—bringing volume back where it’s been lost due to aging or other factors.

Who Needs Dermal Fillers?

You might be a good candidate for dermal fillers if you experience:

  • Deep lines around the mouth and nose (nasolabial folds)
  • Hollow cheeks or temples
  • Thin or asymmetrical lips
  • Under-eye hollowness or dark circles
  • Sagging jawline or chin
  • Visible aging on hands
  • General facial fatigue or loss of structure

Types of Dermal Fillers at Facelit Clinic, Trivandrum

> View this post on Instagram > > > > A post shared by facelit (@facelitclinics)

Not all fillers are the same. At Facelit Clinic, we carefully select the right filler based on your goals, skin type, and facial structure.

  1. Hyaluronic Acid Fillers

Popular Brands: Juvederm, Restylane, Belotero Best for: Lips, cheeks, under-eyes, laugh lines Benefits: Hydrating, reversible, safe for most skin types Ideal if you’re new to fillers or want subtle results

  1. Calcium Hydroxylapatite (CaHA)

Best for: Deeper lines, facial sculpting, jawline Benefits: Stimulates collagen production, lasts longer Suitable for clients looking for structural enhancement

  1. Poly-L-lactic Acid (PLLA)

Best for: Full-face rejuvenation, volume loss correction Benefits: Gradual collagen build-up, long-term results Perfect if you want slow, natural-looking improvement

  1. Autologous Fat Grafting (Fat Transfer)

Best for: Natural, long-term volume enhancement Benefits: Uses your own fat, zero synthetic fillers Ideal for patients seeking permanent facial volume restoration

Real Benefits of Dermal Fillers

Clients at Facelit Clinic often come in with common frustrations like, “I look older than I feel,” or “I want to look fresh without surgery.”

Here’s how dermal fillers solve those problems:

Immediate results—You’ll see a visible difference right after treatment No downtime—walk in, walk out, and get back to your routine Non-surgical & minimally invasive – No scars, no cuts Custom-tailored results—We shape, define, and enhance only where needed Confidence booster—when you look good, you feel unstoppable Long-lasting—Depending on the filler, results last 6–24 months

FAQ

  • 1. What are dermal fillers, and how do they work?

    Dermal fillers are injectable gels that restore volume and smooth out wrinkles by plumping up targeted areas of the face. Most are made of hyaluronic acid, a naturally occurring substance in the body.

  • 2. Are dermal fillers safe for all skin types?

    Yes. Dermal fillers are generally safe for all skin types when administered by trained professionals using FDA-approved products.

  • 3. How long do dermal fillers last?

    Depending on the type and area treated, dermal fillers can last between 6 months to 2 years.

  • 4. What is the recovery time after getting dermal fillers?

    Most people experience little to no downtime. Mild swelling or bruising may occur but typically resolves within 24–48 hours.

  • 5. Can dermal fillers be reversed if I don’t like the results?

    Yes, hyaluronic acid fillers can be dissolved with an enzyme called hyaluronidase, offering a safe reversal if needed.

  • 6. How much do dermal fillers cost in Trivandrum?

    The cost varies based on the type of filler and area treated. On average, it ranges from or session at Facelit Clinic

  • 7. What’s the difference between Botox and dermal fillers?

    Botox relaxes muscles to reduce dynamic wrinkles, while fillers add volume and smooth out static wrinkles or sunken areas.

  • 8. Do dermal fillers hurt?

    Most patients report only mild discomfort. Numbing cream or anesthetic is used to ensure a comfortable experience.

  • 9. How do I know which filler is right for me?

    Your doctor at Facelit Clinic will evaluate your facial structure and recommend the best filler type based on your goals and skin condition.

  • 10. Can I combine dermal fillers with other treatments?

    Yes. Fillers are often combined with Botox, skin boosters, or laser treatments for a comprehensive facial rejuvenation plan.
